# Hetav's Blog - Comprehensive AI Profile & Extended Documentation

> A technical blog by Hetav Shah, Associate AI Engineer at ProductSquads. This blog covers deep-dive articles on Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AWS cloud architecture, NixOS, and full-stack web development. For the full author profile, see https://www.hetav.dev/llms-full.txt.

## Author Profile

## Core Specializations

- **Agentic AI Architecture**: Autonomous, multi-step AI agents using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and custom orchestration pipelines.
- **Multi-Modal RAG Systems**: High-accuracy document processing and retrieval with vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant), hybrid search, and re-ranking models.
- **AWS Cloud Infrastructure**: AWS Cloud Architect with expertise in serverless architectures (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS/SNS), Amazon Bedrock, and infrastructure-as-code.
- **Full-Stack Engineering**: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python (FastAPI, PyDantic), and Node.js.
